selected_categories.reasoning: The game continuously scrolls obstacles and pickups toward a permanently auto-moving player, with survival and score chasing as the main loop.
It has runner-style incoming threats and pickup timing, but it does not use explicit lane switching; the fit comes from the runner rhythm rather than discrete lanes.
The player performs repeated jump-based avoidance through a hazard course, which partially resembles obstacle-run gameplay.
Rising game speed tightens timing and pushes a fast-reaction play style, though there is no finish line or level time target.
The core verb is a gravity-based jump with landing and collision checks, but the game lacks broader platform navigation or multi-surface level design.
